title: Promo
description: A sitewide promo bar composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Button, Alert and Skeleton primitives: a bold offer with a short detail, a promo code that copies itself on press, one action and a dismiss that hides the bar, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the detail joins the offer's line at @sm, the code and action move beside the text at @md (the detail back under the offer) and everything shares one centred line at @lg.
